title: Touch Yourself for Me (Video (Standard))
description: My old mic broke so I had to get a new mic... Decided to upgrade a lil bit and thus today was allll about putting it through it's paces. I just had to see how well it could pick up sounds... like the sound of me moaning, the sound of me whispering... the sound of me playing with myself. It sounds great by the way - but don't just take my word on it, I added a bit to my noises here and there, and made a very layered JOI. Now won't you touch yourself for me?
author: Mistress Shibby
